blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan dl Sur — Indigenous communities across Butuan City converged on Friday to mark the National Indigenous Peoples (IP) Month. They are also celebrating the 29th anniversary of the Indigenous Peoples’ Rights Act (IPRA) of 1997 through sacred rituals, chants and traditional dances. The gathering is organized by the City Tourism and Cultural Affairs Department. It came ahead of the nationwide commemoration of the signing of IPRA (Republic Act No. 8371) on Oct. 29, 1997. The milestone law recognizes ancestral domain rights and the cultural integrity of the country’s indigenous cultural communities. Spearheaded under Presidential Proclamation No. 1906, which […]...
